items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: I was playing with Pete, sitting in with him, the night that I met Jo Jones.

ctx.x: I think Pete was a wonderful piano player, don't you?
Oh, yeah. I was playing with Pete, sitting in with him, the night that I met Jo Jones.

items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: I got Gus Johnson in '48... Gus stayed there till Basie's band broke up, you know, '50 or '51.

ctx.x: He had been in there when you were in the Army?

Yes, and he came back but after that I still had to go and Shadow didn't stay there and I went and got Gus Johnson in '48. But there was another little drummer in there before then and I don't know where he went, because I got up out of a sick bed to fly all the way to Chicago to make a recording with Basie on his drums - my drums were somewhere.
